snippet.title: 「MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA」Teaser PV
snippet.description:
MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA is back and better than ever!
Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray!

A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream.

Set for Early 2027 Release

Official Website：http://meltyblood.twilumina-en.com/?utm_source=media&utm_campaign=evj_26
